Revision-bound theorem audit receipt.run:
set -euo pipefail
repo_root=$(python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; print(Path.cwd().resolve())')
cd "$repo_root"
temp_root=$(python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import sys; print(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(strict=True))' "$RUNNER_TEMP")
lean_executable=$(elan which lean)
lean_toolchain=$(python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import sys; print(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(strict=True).parent.parent)' "$lean_executable")
guard="$repo_root/scripts/build-guard.py"
guard_sha=$(python3 -c 'import hashlib,sys; from pathlib import Path; print(hashlib.sha256(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()).hexdigest())' "$guard")
receipt_parent=$(mktemp -d "$temp_root/proof-receipt.XXXXXX")
export AIR2LEAN_BUILD_LOCK="$temp_root/air2lean-build.lock"
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
# BEGIN proof receipt compiler stash
compiler_stash=$(mktemp -d "$temp_root/proof-receipt-compilers.XXXXXX")
restore_receipt_compilers() {
  original_status=$?
  trap - EXIT
  restore_failed=0
  for compiler in host-zig zig-air-0.16.0; do
    if [ -e "$compiler_stash/$compiler" ] || [ -L "$compiler_stash/$compiler" ]; then
      if [ -e "$repo_root/$compiler" ] || [ -L "$repo_root/$compiler" ]; then
        echo "proof receipt compiler restore collision: $repo_root/$compiler; retained $compiler_stash/$compiler" >&2
        restore_failed=1
      elif ! mv -T --no-clobber -- "$compiler_stash/$compiler" "$repo_root/$compiler"; then
        echo "proof receipt compiler restore failed: $compiler_stash/$compiler" >&2
        restore_failed=1
      elif [ -e "$compiler_stash/$compiler" ] || [ -L "$compiler_stash/$compiler" ]; then
        echo "proof receipt compiler restore skipped; retained $compiler_stash/$compiler" >&2
        restore_failed=1
      fi
    fi
  done
  if [ "$original_status" -eq 0 ] && [ "$restore_failed" -ne 0 ]; then original_status=2; fi
  exit "$original_status"
}
# Install before validation or either move; a partial setup also restores owned roots.
trap restore_receipt_compilers EXIT
python3 - "$repo_root" "$compiler_stash" <<'PYSTASH'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, sys
root, stash = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
if root.resolve(strict=True) != root or stash.resolve(strict=True) != stash or stash.is_relative_to(root):
    raise SystemExit('proof receipt compiler stash requires physical paths outside the checkout')
names = ('host-zig', 'zig-air-0.16.0')
tracked = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(root), 'ls-files', '-z', '--', *names],
                         check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=5).stdout
if tracked:
    raise SystemExit('proof receipt compiler roots contain tracked files')
for name in names:
    path = root / name
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_dir() or path.resolve(strict=True) != path:
        raise SystemExit('proof receipt compiler root must be a physical directory: ' + str(path))
PYSTASH
for compiler in host-zig zig-air-0.16.0; do
  mv -T --no-clobber -- "$repo_root/$compiler" "$compiler_stash/$compiler"
  if [ -e "$repo_root/$compiler" ] || [ -L "$repo_root/$compiler" ]; then
    echo "proof receipt compiler stash move incomplete: $repo_root/$compiler" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
done
# END proof receipt compiler stash
bash tests/roadmap/proof-receipts/check.sh \
  --guard "$guard" --guard-sha256 "$guard_sha" \
  "$receipt_parent/attempt" "$lean_toolchain" ci-linux-0.16-all-shipped
